coverage: All ten pinned source images/frames first. Then all twelve paired canon before/candidate wholes across three eras and both lights. Then all three era paired head closeups, Builder candidate eight angles under both lights, paired Builder cardinal angles both lights and body/feet/side details, Maker/Mechanic paired rear180 neutral/opposite profile090 workshop/profile270 neutral. concrete_gains.finding: Gold main crown panel becomes darker neutral grey, reducing a large isolated bright/gold patch in all three era paired canon wholes and head details. This is a small color-balance move toward dark regional metal in the locked and era references.
concrete_gains.scope: Visible at whole size; no improved crown construction or full head identity established.

concrete_costs.finding: Candidate main crown remains broad, plain and smooth. The visible brushed/gold variation of before is replaced by a flatter-looking grey surface; this can reinforce the existing smooth helmet impression rather than the source riveted layered plate construction.
concrete_costs.scope: Head closeups and frontal views; no inference about actual material graphs/maps.

concrete_costs.finding: No important new body, feet, opposite-profile, stance or rear cost discerned in inspected paired pixels. This is selective analytical visual evidence, not proof of unchanged native geometry or all-view pixel equality.

dominant_source_gaps: Crown/forehead remains a smooth oversized helmet with exposed cutout and long sparse rear crest; references show tightly layered, riveted swept plates.
Bill, optic surround and cheek still read as large simple shells/tubes, with much less dense recessed hardware and edge articulation than July head and locked canon.
Breast plates remain bulky/repetitive with suspended lower breast/hip gap and throat/shoulder discontinuity visible in profiles.
Maker and Mechanic are still nearly the same finish in these static renders; distinct newly fabricated/aged-repaired surfaces are not established.
Mechanical legs/toes and shield-wing fine surface construction remain simplified relative to source; nightmare screen presence is still distant.
provisional_visual_conclusion: Very small local crown color improvement with no observed important regional/rear regression. At most a bounded development retention increment; it does not establish meaningful broad whole-character source convergence, photoreal completion or owner likeness acceptance. Technical packet sufficiency remains unreviewed until phase2.
uncertainty: Camera registration/depth and source correspondences are estimated, not calibrated.
Static source video frames inspected; no motion continuity or new animation acceptance.
No producer contract/claims, receipts, modules, technical reports or other current QA read during this phase.
No material/native/GLB/browser/build custody assertions made from image appearance.
